title.narrative: NICFI 26-28: DUH: Reducing deforestation through imp corp legal complian

description.narrative: Voluntary actions by private actors to prevent forest loss through commodity supply chains and investment portfolios have proven insufficient. The project therefore aims to equip enforcement agencies and civil society with actionable legal evidence on deforestation-related violations. By increasing the availability and use of such evidence, the project seeks to contribute to a higher number of legal and regulatory interventions, thereby raising the legal and reputational risks for companies involved in deforestation, either directly or through their supply chains and financial portfolios. Anticipating these risks, buyers and financiers are expected to adopt precautionary and corrective measures, increasing market and financial pressure on non-compliant companies. Over time, these combined legal and market signals are expected to incentivize changes in business practices and contribute to reduced deforestation and enhanced accountability across global supply chains.
